verdict.rationale: Figma's own marketing confirms that commenting is built into shared design files. The webhook docs and a community user also confirm that collaborators comment on files, so in-file review is supported at its core. Nothing in the pack documents @-mentioning teammates or resolving comment threads, which are two of the story's three named elements. missing for 10: evidence of @-mentions in comments, evidence of resolving threads, in-depth comment documentation, hands-on corroboration of the full review workflow.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can comment directly on designs, mention teammates, and resolve threads so review happens in the file, not in email

citations.quote: Work together in multiplayer files, share feedback with comments, and talk to your teammates with cursor chat in one shared space.
For example: a collaborator comments on a file
